title: Run request v1
description: Body of POST /runs on the agent runtime: one task to run (D12, D13).

task.description: What the user asked, as the first user message of the run.

seed.description: Sampling seed sent with every LLM call of the run, so a run can be repeated; absent for random sampling.

files.description: CSV files attached to the task, kept with the run; the tools take them by id and they never enter the context (D13). Their number and size are limited by agent.max_files and agent.max_file_bytes in config/.

id.description: Lowercase slug the model names the file by; unique within the request.

name.description: The file name as the user attached it.

content.description: The file's text: UTF-8 CSV with a header row.
